figures.title: Can we predict who gets hurt without retraining?
figures.caption: Each point is a recipient subgroup: x = closed-form prediction ρ·μ⁺ᵀv_T, y = measured mean logit decrease on unchanged positive test cases after actually retraining (mean and 95% range over seeds).

figures.title: Audit without retraining: every possible source error
figures.caption: Rows = which subgroup's positives are mislabelled at client 0; columns = recipient subgroups elsewhere. Boxed = most-hit recipient; dotted = the same-named group. Off-diagonal boxes are the paper's warning.

figures.title: Linearity in ρ, and the direction of propagation
figures.caption: Left: the measured effect grows ≈ proportionally with the flipped fraction, as Eq. 3 predicts. Right: the propagation vector; recipients whose positive-case means project further along it lose more.
